options.A: All humans are equal in inherent dignity, full stop

items.text: A genius who contributes enormously vs. someone with severe cognitive disabilities who contributes little. Are they equal?

options.A: Yes—equal in fundamental human dignity and worth
options.B: Equal in moral worth, different in contribution
options.C: Different kinds of value that are incomparable
options.D: Equal in some senses but not all
options.E: No—contribution and capability matter for worth

items.text: "All men are created equal" actually means:

options.A: Equal in fundamental dignity and moral rights
options.B: Equal in moral status despite differences in ability
options.C: Equal in potential, different in actualization
options.D: An aspirational ideal rather than factual claim
options.E: A useful fiction that isn't empirically true

interpretation.-2: All humans equal in fundamental worth
